name: festive-invite-reel
description: Make personalised, beat-synced festive party invite reels (9:16) in an Indian-maximalism collage style: swatch-poster colour pairs, funky kinetic type slammed to a voice/meme intro track, a sunburst drop with illustrated cards flipping on every beat, then a second song for the details (auto-rickshaw ride, marigolds, hanging diyas, split-colour date/time/dress-code slides, venue, fireworks, end card). Personalised template: change words, dates, address, songs, palettes, festival. HTML/CSS/JS + Playwright; illustrations via the Atlabs MCP.
